name: Royal Rimecurrant Ice Cream
desc:
A cup of ice cream prepared by Danica herself. Somehow, simply adding "Royal" to its name seems to make it taste even better.
Rumor has it that it was made using a secret recipe only known to the maids of the Zapolyarny Palace, though Danica denies any such thing.

value.text: Revives a character and restores 1,500 HP.
